dynamicSlides.title: BOMBAYDC response: Digital Sales & Acquisition
dynamicSlides.tagline: Business outcome: Increase qualified acquisition and application conversion.
dynamicSlides.leftText:
What the bank experiences
• Low-quality or low-converting leads
• Customers struggle to compare products
• Application and onboarding drop-offs
dynamicSlides.rightText:
Why it persists
• Product pages inform, but do not guide
• Journeys are organised around products, not customer decisions
• Assisted support begins too late in the journey
The opportunity: turn digital channels into clearer, more guided acquisition journeys.

dynamicSlides.title: BOMBAYDC response: Digital Engagement & Relationship Growth
dynamicSlides.tagline: Business outcome: Increase adoption, engagement, product usage, cross-sell and share of wallet among ETB customers.
dynamicSlides.leftText:
What the bank experiences
• Low usage beyond basic transactions
• Weak discovery of relevant products and features
• Cross-sell often feels generic or poorly timed
dynamicSlides.rightText:
Why it persists
• Digital journeys are built around product silos
• Customer data exists, but is not translated into action
• The platform does not recognise important customer moments
The opportunity: make digital banking a relationship-growth channel, not only a transaction channel.

rows.title: MOBILE AND INTERNET BANKING
rows.body: Modernise the core digital banking experience around customer tasks.

rows.title: FEATURE DISCOVERY
rows.body: Make useful features easier to find and understand.

rows.title: FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT
rows.body: Help customers manage money, goals and decisions more clearly.

rows.title: NEXT-BEST ACTIONS
rows.body: Surface timely prompts, actions and product opportunities.

rows.title: LIFE-STAGE JOURNEYS
rows.body: Connect products to moments such as salary, family, travel, savings and borrowing.

rows.title: RELATIONSHIP GROWTH
rows.body: Move from generic offers to relevant guidance and deeper product usage.

dynamicSlides.title: Why servicing still leaks to assisted channels
dynamicSlides.tagline: Digital channels often answer the easy part, but customers still move to human channels for clarity and completion.
dynamicSlides.leftText:
What the bank experiences
• Customers use only a fraction of the platform
• New features launch but do not get adopted
• Engagement drops after onboarding
dynamicSlides.rightText:
Why it persists
• Interfaces are feature-heavy and difficult to navigate
• Journeys are organised around products rather than tasks
• Post-login guidance is limited and often not contextual
The opportunity: design adoption into the platform instead of hoping users discover value on their own.

dynamicSlides.title: What BOMBAYDC brings together
dynamicSlides.tagline: The work requires more than design alone. We combine the disciplines needed to move from business problem to working product.
dynamicSlides.leftText:
What the bank experiences
• High cost to serve
• Repeat calls, branch visits and RM dependency
• Slow or unclear resolution
dynamicSlides.rightText:
Why it persists
• Customers do not know the correct service path
• Digital journeys stop before resolution
• Context is lost across channels and systems
The opportunity: make digital servicing capable of guiding, routing and resolving more needs.
